_doc: Rental cars (plugins/car-rental). Copied to agent/local/config/car-rental.json the first time the plugin is turned on. The user's own car-rental preferences (class, which companies) live in memory on the wiki page named by preferences_page; the playbook reads that page first. preferences_page: the wiki page id with those preferences. aggregators: comparison sites searched first, in order (default in code: the two the link builder knows). direct: rental companies' own sites checked after the aggregators, in order. companies: the fallback company filter for the aggregator links when the preferences page names none. classes: the fallback class filter (compact, midsize, fullsize, suv, minivan). driver_age: the age entered on sites that ask. grace_minutes: how late a return can be before the companies bill another day.
